units.displayText: Nascita gazes at the float, a big smile on her face and sparkles in her eyes.

spans.text: Nascita gazes at the float, a big smile on her face and sparkles in her eyes.

units.rawText: ...You actually want to take part in the show, don't you, Nascita?
units.displayText: ...You actually want to take part in the show, don't you, Nascita?

spans.text: ...You actually want to take part in the show, don't you, Nascita?

units.rawText: Ah... huh? Did you say something, Professor? I'm sorry, I was a little distracted by the float.
units.displayText: Ah... huh? Did you say something, Professor? I'm sorry, I was a little distracted by the float.

spans.text: Ah... huh? Did you say something, Professor? I'm sorry, I was a little distracted by the float.

units.rawText: Professor, look over there, at that girl in the right corner. She might seem quiet now, but she'll be the star of the show's climax!
units.displayText: Professor, look over there, at that girl in the right corner. She might seem quiet now, but she'll be the star of the show's climax!

spans.text: Professor, look over there, at that girl in the right corner. She might seem quiet now, but she'll be the star of the show's climax!

units.rawText: Nascita unconsciously tugs at my sleeve and hops up and down in excitement.
units.displayText: Nascita unconsciously tugs at my sleeve and hops up and down in excitement.

spans.text: Nascita unconsciously tugs at my sleeve and hops up and down in excitement.

units.rawText: I said...!
units.displayText: I said...!

spans.text: I said...!

units.rawText: Huh... Ah, sorry, Professor. Go ahead, I'm listening.
units.displayText: Huh... Ah, sorry, Professor. Go ahead, I'm listening.

spans.text: Huh... Ah, sorry, Professor. Go ahead, I'm listening.

units.rawText: Nascita comes to her senses and looks at me in mild embarrassment.
units.displayText: Nascita comes to her senses and looks at me in mild embarrassment.

spans.text: Nascita comes to her senses and looks at me in mild embarrassment.

units.rawText: The truth is, you still want to do the show, don't you?
units.displayText: The truth is, you still want to do the show, don't you?

spans.text: The truth is, you still want to do the show, don't you?

units.rawText: I look intently at Nascita. The smile slowly fades from her face, but it quickly returns.
units.displayText: I look intently at Nascita. The smile slowly fades from her face, but it quickly returns.

spans.text: I look intently at Nascita. The smile slowly fades from her face, but it quickly returns.

units.rawText: I would be lying if I said I didn't, but...
units.displayText: I would be lying if I said I didn't, but...

spans.text: I would be lying if I said I didn't, but...

units.rawText: Nascita pulls down the mask on top of my head.
units.displayText: Nascita pulls down the mask on top of my head.

spans.text: Nascita pulls down the mask on top of my head.

units.rawText: I'm also happy when I'm with you, Professor.
units.displayText: I'm also happy when I'm with you, Professor.

spans.text: I'm also happy when I'm with you, Professor.

units.rawText: See, they're going to do a Mysterious Warrior show afterward, and we're also wearing Mysterious Warrior masks.
units.displayText: See, they're going to do a Mysterious Warrior show afterward, and we're also wearing Mysterious Warrior masks.

spans.text: See, they're going to do a Mysterious Warrior show afterward, and we're also wearing Mysterious Warrior masks.

units.rawText: You're a monster, I'm a Mysterious Warrior. We're the stars of our own show too.
units.displayText: You're a monster, I'm a Mysterious Warrior. We're the stars of our own show too.

spans.text: You're a monster, I'm a Mysterious Warrior. We're the stars of our own show too.

units.rawText: As I watch Nascita smile through the eyeslits of my mask, I make up my mind.
units.displayText: As I watch Nascita smile through the eyeslits of my mask, I make up my mind.

spans.text: As I watch Nascita smile through the eyeslits of my mask, I make up my mind.

units.rawText: I suddenly draw away from the girl and as she looks on in shock, I start shouting to draw everyone's attention.
units.displayText: I suddenly draw away from the girl and as she looks on in shock, I start shouting to draw everyone's attention.

spans.text: I suddenly draw away from the girl and as she looks on in shock, I start shouting to draw everyone's attention.

units.rawText: Curse you, Mysterious Warrior! To think you'd chase me all the way here!
units.displayText: Curse you, Mysterious Warrior! To think you'd chase me all the way here!

spans.text: Curse you, Mysterious Warrior! To think you'd chase me all the way here!

units.rawText: Eh... eh!?
units.displayText: Eh... eh!?

spans.text: Eh... eh!?

units.rawText: Standing underneath the brightly-lit entrance arch, Nascita seems a little at a loss amidst the onlookers.
units.displayText: Standing underneath the brightly-lit entrance arch, Nascita seems a little at a loss amidst the onlookers.

spans.text: Standing underneath the brightly-lit entrance arch, Nascita seems a little at a loss amidst the onlookers.

units.rawText: Professor, you're...
units.displayText: Professor, you're...

spans.text: Professor, you're...

units.rawText: I grab a stick of candied hawthorn and secretly gesture to the owner before laughing out loud.
units.displayText: I grab a stick of candied hawthorn and secretly gesture to the owner before laughing out loud.

spans.text: I grab a stick of candied hawthorn and secretly gesture to the owner before laughing out loud.

units.rawText: So this is a warrior of justice? You see me commit villainy and do nothing? That's not what a hero would do!
units.displayText: So this is a warrior of justice? You see me commit villainy and do nothing? That's not what a hero would do!

spans.text: So this is a warrior of justice? You see me commit villainy and do nothing? That's not what a hero would do!

units.rawText: What are they doing? Is this some kind of special show?
units.displayText: What are they doing? Is this some kind of special show?

spans.text: What are they doing? Is this some kind of special show?

units.rawText: Ohhhhh! I know this! She's Burbank's Mysterious Warrior, and that monster is a robber!
units.displayText: Ohhhhh! I know this! She's Burbank's Mysterious Warrior, and that monster is a robber!

spans.text: Ohhhhh! I know this! She's Burbank's Mysterious Warrior, and that monster is a robber!

units.rawText: Jeje, you're so slow. Keep up with me if you can!
units.displayText: Jeje, you're so slow. Keep up with me if you can!

spans.text: Jeje, you're so slow. Keep up with me if you can!

units.rawText: Saying so, I turn and vanish into the depths of the crowd.
units.displayText: Saying so, I turn and vanish into the depths of the crowd.

spans.text: Saying so, I turn and vanish into the depths of the crowd.

units.rawText: Uh... hey!
units.displayText: Uh... hey!

spans.text: Uh... hey!

units.rawText: A girl holds up her communicator and points it at Nascita, then starts to film.
units.displayText: A girl holds up her communicator and points it at Nascita, then starts to film.

spans.text: A girl holds up her communicator and points it at Nascita, then starts to film.

units.rawText: Transform already, Mysterious Warrior! Otherwise you won't be able to catch the monster!
units.displayText: Transform already, Mysterious Warrior! Otherwise you won't be able to catch the monster!

spans.text: Transform already, Mysterious Warrior! Otherwise you won't be able to catch the monster!

units.rawText: Nascita closes her eyes. When she opens them again, they're full of the justice and courage that a Mysterious Warrior ought to have.
units.displayText: Nascita closes her eyes. When she opens them again, they're full of the justice and courage that a Mysterious Warrior ought to have.

spans.text: Nascita closes her eyes. When she opens them again, they're full of the justice and courage that a Mysterious Warrior ought to have.

units.rawText: ...That's right. I AM a Mysterious Warrior of Justice!
units.displayText: ...That's right. I AM a Mysterious Warrior of Justice!

spans.text: ...That's right. I AM a Mysterious Warrior of Justice!

units.rawText: O power of the Mysterious Warrior, answer my heart of justice!
units.displayText: O power of the Mysterious Warrior, answer my heart of justice!

spans.text: O power of the Mysterious Warrior, answer my heart of justice!

units.rawText: [Are you ready?]
units.displayText: [Are you ready?]

spans.text: [Are you ready?]

units.rawText: Mysterious Warrior! TRANSFORM!
units.displayText: Mysterious Warrior! TRANSFORM!

spans.text: Mysterious Warrior! TRANSFORM!

units.rawText: <size=40>Ohhhhhhhhh—!</size>
units.displayText: Ohhhhhhhhh—!

spans.text: Ohhhhhhhhh—!

units.rawText: Mysterious Warrior N! Mysterious Warrior N!
units.displayText: Mysterious Warrior N! Mysterious Warrior N!

spans.text: Mysterious Warrior N! Mysterious Warrior N!

units.rawText: Voices fill the air, and the lights turn night to day.
units.displayText: Voices fill the air, and the lights turn night to day.

spans.text: Voices fill the air, and the lights turn night to day.

units.rawText: On the bustling streets, one person chases and another flees.
units.displayText: On the bustling streets, one person chases and another flees.

spans.text: On the bustling streets, one person chases and another flees.

units.rawText: Hold it right there, Professor!
units.displayText: Hold it right there, Professor!

spans.text: Hold it right there, Professor!
(Keep running.)
(Stop and wait.)

units.rawText: Nope! Where would my pride as a villain be if I stopped just because you asked me to!?
units.displayText: Nope! Where would my pride as a villain be if I stopped just because you asked me to!?

spans.text: Nope! Where would my pride as a villain be if I stopped just because you asked me to!?

units.rawText: ...Professor, if we do a show together, I'm going to take you out in the first episode!
units.displayText: ...Professor, if we do a show together, I'm going to take you out in the first episode!

spans.text: ...Professor, if we do a show together, I'm going to take you out in the first episode!

units.rawText: Saying so, Nascita puts on a burst of speed and catches up with me right away.
units.displayText: Saying so, Nascita puts on a burst of speed and catches up with me right away.

spans.text: Saying so, Nascita puts on a burst of speed and catches up with me right away.

units.rawText: Got you!
units.displayText: Got you!

spans.text: Got you!

units.rawText: Uwah, that's the Mysterious Warrior for you.
units.displayText: Uwah, that's the Mysterious Warrior for you.

spans.text: Uwah, that's the Mysterious Warrior for you.

units.rawText: I turn and come to a halt. Nascita doesn't respond in time and crashes into my arms.
units.displayText: I turn and come to a halt. Nascita doesn't respond in time and crashes into my arms.

spans.text: I turn and come to a halt. Nascita doesn't respond in time and crashes into my arms.

units.rawText: Doink—
units.displayText: Doink—

spans.text: Doink—

units.rawText: Ugh...—oof.
units.displayText: Ugh...—oof.

spans.text: Ugh...—oof.

units.rawText: Nascita rubs her nose and shyly disentangles herself from me.
units.displayText: Nascita rubs her nose and shyly disentangles herself from me.

spans.text: Nascita rubs her nose and shyly disentangles herself from me.

units.rawText: Honestly, Professor, you're terrible.
units.displayText: Honestly, Professor, you're terrible.

spans.text: Honestly, Professor, you're terrible.

units.rawText: I learned it from you. After all, didn't you pull this same trick on me in Burbank?
units.displayText: I learned it from you. After all, didn't you pull this same trick on me in Burbank?

spans.text: I learned it from you. After all, didn't you pull this same trick on me in Burbank?

units.rawText: You're so petty, Professor, is this what the great villain of the Oasis is like?
units.displayText: You're so petty, Professor, is this what the great villain of the Oasis is like?

spans.text: You're so petty, Professor, is this what the great villain of the Oasis is like?

units.rawText: Neither of us looks like we're willing to back down, and after our eyes meet, we both burst into laughter.
units.displayText: Neither of us looks like we're willing to back down, and after our eyes meet, we both burst into laughter.

spans.text: Neither of us looks like we're willing to back down, and after our eyes meet, we both burst into laughter.

units.rawText: Feeling better now?
units.displayText: Feeling better now?

spans.text: Feeling better now?

units.displayText: Yup! I'm feeling wonderful.

units.rawText: I was actually okay before that though, it was just a small thing. Having you get all serious about it made me embarrassed instead.

units.rawText: And besides, I still have a long career ahead of me and many more chances to be the lead actress.

spans.text: And besides, I still have a long career ahead of me and many more chances to be the lead actress.

units.rawText: Well, I don't see it that way.
units.displayText: Well, I don't see it that way.

spans.text: Well, I don't see it that way.

units.rawText: I smile and ruffle Nascita's hair, then look up at the fireworks exploding above us.
units.displayText: I smile and ruffle Nascita's hair, then look up at the fireworks exploding above us.

spans.text: I smile and ruffle Nascita's hair, then look up at the fireworks exploding above us.

units.rawText: You'll always be the lead in my heart, and you don't need a script to prove that.
units.displayText: You'll always be the lead in my heart, and you don't need a script to prove that.

spans.text: You'll always be the lead in my heart, and you don't need a script to prove that.

units.rawText: That said, this happened because of me, and I wanted to make it up to you in some way.
units.displayText: That said, this happened because of me, and I wanted to make it up to you in some way.

spans.text: That said, this happened because of me, and I wanted to make it up to you in some way.

units.rawText: What, feeling shy?
units.displayText: What, feeling shy?

spans.text: What, feeling shy?

units.displayText: Nascita bites her lip and then pulls her mask down without saying a word.

units.displayText: Surrender now, wicked Dark Warrior!

units.displayText: Ack—Heeeeelp!
